intro.text: A timid, quiet slave travelling with Tvlakv's group.

items.text: Suna joined Shallan on her journey towards the warcamps of the Shattered Plains.

appearance.text: Wears a tunic and trousers that Shallan got from merchants she had rescued. Like the rest of Tvlakv's group he is tattooed rather than branded, marking a slave's child or someone who entered servitude by choice.
